sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Gold Bead Bracelet with CZ Square Stone for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent: Simple, chic, and endlessly wearable — this gold bead chain bracelet features a dainty square CZ stone charm that adds just the right touch of sparkle. Adjustable lobster clasp with branded coin tag for a premium feel. Anti-tarnish finish perfect for daily wear, gifting, or stacking with your favourite bracelets.
